LanguageData.BOR_TenebralAppendage.label: tenebral appendage template
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralAppendage.description: A template for appendages made from tenebrite. They take the shape of a needed organ.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralOrgan.label: tenebral organ template
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralOrgan.description: A Tenebral-technology organ template, shapes itself into the needed organ.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TI.label: solar neutronium condenser
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TI.description: A Solarite-engineered machine that draws neutronium from deep subsurface deposits, channeling vast solar energies to stabilize and accumulate the volatile matter. The foundation of any neutronium operation.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TII.label: quasar neutronium condenser
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TII.description: A Kwazaari condenser employing quasar-lattice resonance to draw neutronium from the deep at twice the efficiency of solar designs. The exotic alloys within sustain extraction rates that no Solarite machine could match.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TIII.label: tenebral neutronium condenser
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TIII.description: The pinnacle of Tenebral engineering. This condenser siphons neutronium from the deep with terrifying efficiency, its tenebrite core operating at the edge of known physical limits. Those who built it did not need to understand it - only to use it.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumPipe.label: neutronium pipe
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumPipe.description: BOR_Sunsteel pipes designed to transport usable neutronium
LanguageData.BOR_UndergroundNeutroniumPipe.label: hidden neutronium pipe
LanguageData.BOR_UndergroundNeutroniumPipe.descriptio: Hidden Sunsteel pipes designed to transport usable neutronium
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumValve.label: neutronium valve
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumTank.label: neutronium tank
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumTank.description: An industrial liquid storage tank meant for storing neutronium delivered via neutronium pipe network. Tanks can be designated to be siphoned for usable neutronium as needed. If damaged even lightly the escaping fumes will very swiftly create a gaseous fireball, the size of the resulting explosion will depend on the amount stored within.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumTap.label: neutronium tap
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumTap.description: A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed neutronium from tanks periodically for use later.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumDrain.label: neutronium drain
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumDrain.description: A hopper-like storage basin meant to input neutronium into the network, filling up connected tanks.
LanguageData.BOR_InfiniteNeutroniumGenerator.label: tenebral neutronium selfsustained generator
LanguageData.BOR_InfiniteNeutroniumGenerator.descript: Slowly generates neutronium from particulate matter in the air.
LanguageData.BOR_GameOfUrBoard.label: game-of-ur holoboard
LanguageData.BOR_GameOfUrBoard.description: Dating from 2500BC, this exciting yet infuriating board game can be played by one or two people. This particular board is enhanced with holo-projectors capable of making the game more engaging and/or challenging, alongside allowing for a single player to play against a Computerized opponent. It trains intellectual skills.
LanguageData.BOR_ChessTable.label: chess holotable
LanguageData.BOR_ChessTable.description: A high-tech version of this most ancient board game with an onboard Artificial Intelligence and holo-projectors. It trains intellectual skills.\n\nThis building requires adjacent chairs or stools to use.
LanguageData.BOR_PokerTable.label: poker holotable
LanguageData.BOR_PokerTable.description: A highly advanced table designed for gambling and playing card games like poker. It has been enhanced with holographic technology to improve the user experience, removing the need for physical cards.\n\nThis building requires adjacent chairs or stools to use.
LanguageData.BOR_BilliardsTable.label: billiards holotable
LanguageData.BOR_BilliardsTable.description: A highly advanced pool table designed to play a variety of games such as billiards utilizing holographic projectors. It trains shooting ability.
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_I.label: solarscreen television
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_I.description: A massive high-tech television. Gigantic, hyper-vibrant images almost leap out of the screen. Very entertaining. Capable of picking up transmissions from most sources within the cosmos.
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_I.label: holotelescope
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_I.description: An advanced telescope that provides a clear enough picture for Professional astronomy. It's a relaxing hobby for a certain kind of person. Can only be used outdoors.
LanguageData.BOR_PC_I.label: solarite personal computer
LanguageData.BOR_PC_I.description: A high tech computer utilizing Sunsteel to vastly improve its performance, capable of running Crysis 2 on max settings for a whole half hour without overheating. Gives a boost to learning after use.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_I.label: solar fluid simulation array
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_I.description: Increases research speed when placed near hi-tech research bench and unlocks Solarite research projects. Each research bench can only use one solar fluid simulation array
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_I.label: holotool cabinet
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_I.description: Increases work speed when placed near a workbench via hardlight projection technology. One workbench can use up to three holo-cabinets.
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_I.label: solar moisture pump
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_I.description: Very slowly equalizes moisture in nearby terrain, converting marshes or shallow water into dry ground, and soft sand into normal sand. Does not affect deep water.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGeothermalPowerGenerator.label: solar geothermal generator
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGeothermalPowerGenerator.descri: A vast improvement over the conventional Geothermal Generator, the marvels of Sunsteel foster a more excitable environment in which power can be generated from the heat of the Planet. [DBH]Additionally capable of harvesting and dispensing superheated water vapor at far more... palatable temperatures.[/DBH]
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_I.label: solarite reactor
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_I.description: An advanced Fission Reactor which can draw safely upon the power housed within Solarite Fuel Rods. \n\n"The power of the Sun, within the palm of my hands." -Octavius the Wisened, moments before the first Solarite Meltdown.
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_I.label: solarite battery
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_I.description: An immeasurably dense rectangle of molded Sunsteel housing cells capable of storing the average power needs for an entire urbworld neighborhood, the nature of their construction leaves them open to the air in order to maintain molecular stability - as such it is advised to keep these batteries away from water, fire, and airborne mortar shells.
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_II.label: quasarscreen television
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_II.description: A gargantuan holo-screen capable of providing some of the most entertaining programs within the current and adjacent sectors, satisfaction guaranteed.
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_II.label: quasoscope
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_II.description: A powerful telescope capable of observing the fusion and decay of stars near and far. Due to budget cuts this model can only be used outdoors.
LanguageData.BOR_PC_II.label: kwazaari personal computer
LanguageData.BOR_PC_II.description: An ultratech computer utilizing enviro-sculpt technologies allowing for the user to be entirely immersed in all tasks the perform thanks to high-fidelity holo-projectors. Gives a considerable boost to learning after use.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_II.label: sigma-class sagittary autoscope
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_II.description: Increases research speed when placed near a hi-tech research bench, additionally unlocking quasar research projects. Each research bench can only use one sigma-class sagittary autoscope.
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_II.label: tool kwaazbinet
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_II.description: Greatly improves work speed when placed near workbenches. One workbench can use up to four kwaazbinets at a time, buy buy buy!.
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_II.label: kwazaari moisture pump
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_II.description: Very slowly equalizes moisture in nearby terrain, converting marshes or shallow water into dry ground, and soft sand into normal sand. Does not affect deep water.
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_II.label: epsilon-class neutronium reactor
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_II.description: Produces power by splitting neutronium into electrons and protons. Must be fuelled via pipelines.
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_II.label: quasar battery
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_II.description: Stores massive amounts of electrical power by making use of Quasar Alloy's durability and resistance to both heat and static discharge when compared to more mundane materials. One Quasar Battery is often given complementarily with Neutronium reactors if supplied with a sufficient coupon, but good luck getting one of those out here.\n\n Due to lax safety regulations, this pattern of Quasar Battery is produced without hydrophobic layering or thermo-regulative panels, so keep it away from rain and fire.
LanguageData.BOR_Bench_II.label: Kwazifab Quasar Fabricator
LanguageData.BOR_Bench_II.description: A work station for assembling Quasar-based technology, all originally patented within Kwazaari mercantile space.
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_II.label: theta forge
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_II.description: Used to compose Neutronium into usable items.
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineBench_II.label: kwazaari medical fabricator
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineBench_II.description: An offshoot Kwazifab workbench equipped with kwaztainers, kwazheaters, and chemical kwazynthesizers for producing various drugs and medicines, patent pending.
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_II.label: hydrokwaesar 630 gro-master
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_II.description: An artificial nutrient bath for growing plants at blistering speed. Due to limits on the cost of manufacture there is no internal power supply to sustain the apparatus in case of outage. In short: the plants will begin to die if power is cut.
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_Tileable_II.label: hydrokwaesar 630 gro-minor
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_Tileable_II.descrip: A compact and customizable nutrient bath for growing plants at blistering speed. Due to limits on the cost of manufacture there is no internal power supply to sustain the apparatus in case of outage. In short: the plants will begin to die if power is cut.
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_III.label: darkscreen television
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_III.description: An incomparably massive entertainment device. Tenebrite Crystal Displays coupled with auditory suites of the highest caliber sometimes fool people into forgetting they're watching a movie, TV show, or video game.
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_III.label: dark telescope
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_III.description: A telescopic array designed to monitor and observe potential threats to Tenebral claims, though its extensive scanning capabilities alongside the dizzying levels of zoom lend itself to recreational stargazing perfectly. It was never intended to see any form of danger, and can only be used outdoors as a result.
LanguageData.BOR_PC_III.label: tenebral personal computer
LanguageData.BOR_PC_III.description: An incomparable computer utilizing Tenebral Crystal Displays (TCDs) for visual clarity without peer while also harboring enough processing power to render fourth dimensional objects, should you have enough experience to even do so. Comes with a free copy of DOOM and gives a massive boost to learning after use.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_III.label: dark mirror
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_III.description: Increases research speed when placed near hi-tech research bench and unlocks tenebral research projects. Each research bench can only peer into one dark mirror.
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_III.label: dark manufacturer
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_III.description: Increases work speed by a frightening degree when placed near a workbench. One workbench can use up to five dark manufacturers.
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_III.label: tenebral moisture pump
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_III.description: Very slowly equalizes moisture in nearby terrain, converting marshes or shallow water into dry ground, and soft sand into normal sand. Does not affect deep water.
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_III.label: dark reactor
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_III.description: Produces power by stealing momentum from ubiquitous non-interacting particles - which amounts to 'free energy' in simple, small words.
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_III.label: tenebral battery
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_III.description: Stores apocalyptic amounts of electricity for later use. This model has been designed for civilian use, and as such it has no countermeasures to account for rain and fire.
LanguageData.BOR_Bench_III.label: dark fabricator
LanguageData.BOR_Bench_III.description: A work station for assembling Tenebrite-based technology.
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_III.label: dark forge
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_III.description: Used to compose Neutronium into usable items.
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineBench_III.label: tenebral medical fabricator
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineBench_III.description: A workbench well-stocked with all manner of mind-bending equipment designed to produce various drugs, often stimulants or medicines.
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_III.label: tenebral hydrogrower
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_III.description: An ultratech nutrient bath commonly used to grow medicinal plants or natural stimulants, allowing for them to sprout and flourish at such a frightening rate the naked eye can observe its growth. Stripped down to lower the cost of manufacture there is no emergency power cell within the basin, which means that in the event of power loss the plants within will begin to die, and may die completely if power is not restored in a timely manner.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_IV.label: umbral spire
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_IV.description: Increases research speed when placed near hi-tech research bench and unlocks Umbral research projects. Each research bench can only entreat one Umbral spire.
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_IV.label: umbral reactor
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_IV.description: A limitless source of energy, fabricating and collapsing micro-singularities within multi-layered stratus to provide limitless energy while maintaing the integrity of realspace. It is inadvised to let this device come to harm, lest the singularities become unstable.
LanguageData.BOR_Bench_IV.label: umbral creation engine
LanguageData.BOR_Bench_IV.description: A fabricator so advanced it is nearly beyond comprehension, used to create Umbral technologies.
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_IV.label: umbral forge
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_IV.description: A mind-bending device capable of shaping Neutronium into all things the mortal mind could possibly fathom, and then some.
LanguageData.BOR_Femtoclusters.label: femtoclusters
LanguageData.BOR_Femtoclusters.description: An opaque apparatus filled with femtoscopic machines, clustered and waiting for an order. Container is made from picomachines and has neither a reader or an applicator. Picocluster contantly spreads and shrinks around the container, unnoticeable to naked eye; approaching user has their intentions read before they even lay eyes on the apparatus. Femtomachines are kept enclosed only because they have nowhere else to be and exit through the pores of the surrounding cluster when intent is understood.
LanguageData.BOR_Picoclusters.label: picoclusters
LanguageData.BOR_Picoclusters.description: An opaque apparatus filled with picoscopic machines, clustered and waiting for an order. The container only has a tiny hole on the bottom. Entire container is built by nanomachines, so a reader is unneeded. Picomachines exit through the hole when intent is understood. Typically used for installation.
LanguageData.BOR_Nanoclusters.label: nanoclusters
LanguageData.BOR_Nanoclusters.description: An opaque apparatus filled with nanoscopic machines, clustered and waiting for an order. The container has an electronic reader on top and a needle-like applicator on the bottom. Electronic reader transmits intentions of the user into the nanocluster, and the applicator deploys them. Typically used for installation.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FlakVest.label: solar flak vest
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FlakVest.description: A molded sunsteel plate fashioned to protect the torso. Conventional weaponry may do little but scratch the material, but it does nothing to protect your limbs.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FlakPants.label: solar flak pants
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FlakPants.description: Protective legwear with molded Sunsteel inserts, effective at stopping many forms of leg-based assault while remaining comfortable to wear.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FlakJacket.label: solar flak jacket
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FlakJacket.description: A protective garment with molded sunsteel plates inserted into the front and back of the garb. Not as effective as Solid armor but far more comfortable and insulating
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_PowerArmor.label: solar marine armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_PowerArmor.description: A suit of powered armor made from Sunsteel. Layered sunsteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Egotistical soldiers often boast they can take an Anti-Tank Missile without so much as a scratch, and unfortunately they are often correct.\n\nWhile not common, Solar Republics are known to employ this armor against rival claimants.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorRecon.label: solar recon armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorRecon.description: Partially-powered armor, designed for mobility and ease-of-use. Meshes of Sunsteel Weave block attacks without adding excessive weight, and a complex endomuscular system in the lower body allows for uncompromised movement.\n\nArmor such as this is often employed by solar scout troops and higher-end police forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_PowerArmorHelmet.label: solar marine helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_PowerArmorHelmet.descr: A Powered Solar helmet, complete with Tactical H.U.D. and Mounted Headlamp.\n\nHeadgear of this caliber is often used by Shock Troopers of the Solar Republics, and on rare occasion influential Psycasters.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetRecon.label: solar recon helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetRecon.descr: A semi-powered Solar helmet with built-in status computer and binocular array.\n\nHelmets of this pedigree are often used by Solar scout troops and sharpshooters.
LanguageData.BOR_QuantumRebreatherMask.label: quantum rebreather mask
LanguageData.BOR_QuantumRebreatherMask.description: A filtered quantum rebreather built for hazardous substrate work. The mask stabilizes breathing feedback and keeps the wearer steady in environments where fine pressure control matters more than raw armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunforge_Calibration_Visor.label: sunforge calibration visor
LanguageData.BOR_Sunforge_Calibration_Visor.descripti: A narrow visor that filters glare and timing drift for precision forging. It is tuned to keep the wearer visually locked onto heat gradients, seams, and microscopic alignment cues.
LanguageData.BOR_Quantum_Haptic_Gloves.label: quantum haptic gloves
LanguageData.BOR_Quantum_Haptic_Gloves.description: Fine haptic gloves tuned for microscopic substrate handling. They translate tactile feedback into stable, deliberate motion without relying on item quality to do the work.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunforge_Welders_Coat.label: sunforge welder's coat
LanguageData.BOR_Sunforge_Welders_Coat.description: A heat-resistant coat with embedded field-dampening panels. It keeps the wearer comfortable at the forge while supporting exact motion through the shoulders and arms.
LanguageData.BOR_Bionic_Assembly_Harness.label: bionic assembly harness
LanguageData.BOR_Bionic_Assembly_Harness.description: A reinforced torso harness that braces the shoulders, steadies the upper back, and gives the wearer a rigid work posture suitable for precise assembly.
LanguageData.BOR_Precision_Assembly_Gloves.label: precision assembly gloves
LanguageData.BOR_Precision_Assembly_Gloves.descriptio: Structured sensor gloves with haptic sub-dermal guides. They reward careful hands and steady pressure with a quality-dependent boost to assembly speed.
LanguageData.BOR_Aegis.label: aegis
LanguageData.BOR_Aegis.description: A cheap Preventative sold in bulk by the Kwazaari. The drug renders those who ingest it immune to malaria, sleeping sickness, plague, influenza, and parasitic infections. Must be taken every eight days in order to continue its effects.\n\nThis drug does not cure existing infections - but is capable of preventing any and all that have yet to take root, even those not yet discovered.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunlite.label: sunlite
LanguageData.BOR_Sunlite.description: A simplified version of the Drug 'Sunlight' mass-produced for export and sale by the Kwazaari - The product makes use of Sunweave, having its powerful fibers dried and minced into a fine powder which is then added to water. When drank, it produces an extremely euphoric high, dramatically reducing the user's need for rest while suppressing a majority of their pain receptors. Due to acceptable levels of imperfection, Sunlite is not without risk and widely considered 'moderately addictive' outside of Kwazaari Legal Space.
LanguageData.BOR_Trot.label: trot
LanguageData.BOR_Trot.description: A performance-enhancing demi-steroid originally developed to combat Carpal Tunnel Syndrome. Trot almost entirely negates pain while instilling an Adrenal reaction which increases the user's movement speed and improves their combat abilities.\n\nThe compound is Addictive, though lax quality control and loose drug regulations within Kwazaari sectors see the substance prolifically used all over the stars.
LanguageData.BOR_WideAWake.label: wide-a-wake
LanguageData.BOR_WideAWake.description: A synthetic stimulant often used by Laborers within Solar Republics, The compound purges toxins within the brain and allows for prolonged periods without requiring rest - often this time is used to meet brutal quotas. The original recipe traces back to Kwazaari mercantile sectors and is tailored to the needs of individual Republics. \n\nThis formula uses an addictive chemical in order to stabilize the Ph levels, and as such is not without risk in its use.
LanguageData.BOR_FuelRod.label: solarite fuel rod
LanguageData.BOR_FuelRod.description: A sunsteel container housing a remarkable - and frightening - amount of energy which can only be exploited safely in the confines of a Solarite Reactor. \n\nNormally you would be capable of asking what happens when one of these Fuel Rods goes critical, but unfortunately craters the size of a lake cannot answer your queries.
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineI.label: solarite medicine
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineI.description: A kit of almost archeotech medical supplies, though crude by the standards of any self-respecting Solar Republic. It contains advanced polymorphic drugs, a nanite diagnostic system with respiratory boosters, a shot of perfectly stirred Rye Whiskey, and various surgical multi-tools.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ShieldBelt.label: solar shield belt
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ShieldBelt.description: A solar projectile-repulsion device. It will attempt to stop incoming projectiles or shrapnel, but does nothing against melee attacks or heat. It prevents the wearer from firing out, and shuts down instantly if hit by EMP.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_Autopistol_TI.label: solar pistol bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_Shotgun_TI.label: shotgun solar blast
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_AssaultRifle_TI.label: assault rifle solar bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_SniperRifle_TI.label: sniper rifle solar bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TI.label: solar pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TI.description: A simple blowback-operated self-loading pistol. Quick to fire with reasonable accuracy, but at the cost of damage and armor penetration.\n\nThis weapon is commonly used by petty criminals within Solar Republics, but can otherwise be found throughout the stars wielded by Crime-Lords or high-end Enforcers
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TI.label: solar chain shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TI.description: A drum-fed fully automatic shotgun, less precise with a shorter effective range than standard models. Oftentimes battles fought between the squabbling Solar Republics have so many warriors doing battle that accuracy is far less important than capacity and rate of fire.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TI.label: solar assault rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TI.description: A general-purpose rifle often issued to Rank-and-File soldiers within Solar Republics, the weapon is moderately effective at all ranges and comes with a built-in holographic 'flip-up' sight. The design has been attributed to a number of Republics, though none of which can verify their claims to its manufacture.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TI.label: solar sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TI.description: A bolt-action 'rifle' which launches shards of Sunsteel at whatever sorry fool the weapon is pointed toward. While having exceptional range, accuracy, and power, the multi-zoom thermal scope cannot be removed and conventional ironsights are not present, causing other weapons to outclass it at close range.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FlakVest.label: quasar flak vest
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FlakVest.description: A pair of solid Quasar Alloy plates sewn together into a protective chestpiece. Renders the wearer nigh-invulnerable to weapons fire, so long as that fire is directed toward their chest or spine, and is not actual 'flame' fire.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FlakPants.label: quasar flak pants
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FlakPants.description: A pair of conventional pants with quasar armor plates sewn in to protect the legs from all manners of assault. Comes with optional kneepads and codpiece to protect any and all parts of the humanoid body*. \n\n*kneepads and codpiece sold separately
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FlakJacket.label: quasar flak jacket
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FlakJacket.descriptio: A conventional jacket with Quasar Alloy plates sewn in to protect vital areas on the torso. It is not advised to try and cut the off sleeves for 'fashion', as functional scissors in the Rim are rare enough without destroying another pair.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PowerArmor.label: quasar marine armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PowerArmor.descriptio: A suit of Powered Armor made from Quasar Alloy. Armor of this caliber in military use is often on strict lend-lease as the inevitable god-complex one acquires while wearing it is considered 'problematic' and/or 'extremely annoying' by most Kwazaari Quartermasters.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorRecon.label: quasar recon armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorRecon.descriptio: A suit of partially-powered armor comprised of Quasar Alloy, complete with internal radio and air-conditioning. A layer of Quasar Weave mesh absorbs attacks without compromising movement, protection, or comfort.\n\nMost commonly this style of Powered Armor is found on less-than-amicable 'Negotiation Agents' and their retinues within and surrounding Kwazaari Sectors.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PowerArmorHelmet.desc: A helmet formed from Quasar Alloy, complete with proprietary IFF (Identify Friend or Foe) software, Short-Range radio, and BallisTek armored camera arrays for maximum Field of View and protection.\n\nNormally it would cost an arm and a leg to get a Helmet of this level, though there are times you may find it on sale for two arms and zero legs, what a steal!
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetRecon.desc: A Helmet forged from Quasar Alloys, complete with a telescopic monocular and long-range radio antenna.\n\nUsually found on 'Profit Hunters', which in reality are forward scouts for the Plutocratic Kwazaari and their endless lust for wealth.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarQuantumRebreatherMask.label: quasar quantum rebreather mask
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarQuantumRebreatherMask.descript: A refined filtered quantum rebreather built for hazardous substrate work.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarSunforgeCalibrationVisor.label: quasar sunforge calibration visor
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarSunforgeCalibrationVisor.descr: A refined visor that filters glare and timing drift for precision forging.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarQuantumHapticGloves.label: quasar quantum haptic gloves
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarQuantumHapticGloves.descriptio: Fine haptic gloves tuned for microscopic substrate handling.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarSunforgeWeldersCoat.label: quasar sunforge welder's coat
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarSunforgeWeldersCoat.descriptio: A heat-resistant coat with improved field-dampening panels.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicAssemblyHarness.label: quasar bionic assembly harness
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicAssemblyHarness.descript: A reinforced torso harness that braces the shoulders and upper back for precision assembly.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarPrecisionAssemblyGloves.label: quasar precision assembly gloves
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarPrecisionAssemblyGloves.descri: Structured sensor gloves with haptic sub-dermal guides.
LanguageData.BOR_Canter.label: canter
LanguageData.BOR_Canter.description: A clean and sterile name for what is effectively the lovechild of Adrenaline, Yayo, and Hyper-Caffeinated Energy Drinks. Canter nullifies pain and pushes the user's physical abilities to their limit. Due to the lax regulations surrounding Kwazaari Food and Drug Sales addictive chemicals are key parts in several compounds that compose the drug, presumably to boost sales.\n\n"There are those who can't, and those who Canter." -Promotional Advertisement
LanguageData.BOR_Castra.label: castra
LanguageData.BOR_Castra.description: A Broad-Spectrum anti-biotic, anti-viral, anti-fungal, anti-parasitic originially sold as a weekly multivitamin. Prevents all known forms of illness and infection the organic body can sustain, but has no effect on infections or ailments which are already combating the immune system.
LanguageData.BOR_Sleepquitin.label: sleepquitin
LanguageData.BOR_Sleepquitin.description: A synthetic stimulant originally derived from plant and animal compounds, proudly sourced from 19% ethical environments.\n\nUsed by a variety of professions within Kwazaari Sectors, most often by Blue Collar workers who are slightly too dissatisfied with their 20 hour work days.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunlight.label: sunlight
LanguageData.BOR_Sunlight.description: A form of Sunlite, the Sunweave-based drug, improved by the introduction of Quasar Alloy Chunks (sold separately) which are ground into a powder and mixed heartily with the orginial drug.\n\nThe Quasar dust added to Sunlight does not harbor an addiction risk, but the addictive chemicals in base Sunlite still linger within the drug albeit to a lesser extent.
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineII.label: first kwaed kit
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineII.description: A kit of medical supplies so advanced they can almost perform surgeries on their own, though not without pop-up ads. It contains quasimorphic drug synthesizers, microsecond coagulant agents, a wireless medical scanner and handheld vitals monitor, and two emergency cyanide pills.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ShieldBelt.label: quasar shield belt
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ShieldBelt.descriptio: A quasar projectile-repulsion device. It will attempt to stop incoming projectiles or shrapnel, but does nothing against melee attacks or heat. It prevents the wearer from firing out, and shuts down instantly if hit by EMP.
LanguageData.BOR_Longsword.label: kwazaari sword
LanguageData.BOR_Longsword.description: A sword forged from Quasar Alloy and sharpened within a molecule of width, a somewhat mundane yet occasionally useful weapon in Kwaazari society.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_Autopistol_TII.label: quasar pistol bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_Shotgun_TII.label: shotgun quasar blast
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_AssaultRifle_TII.label: assault rifle quasar bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_SniperRifle_TII.label: sniper rifle quasar bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_LMG_TII.label: LMG quasar bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TII.label: kwazaari pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TII.description: A simple semi-automatic pistol mass-produced from a Free-to-Use template which had its patent run out. Vastly superior to conventional firearms in many aspects aside from range and accuracy.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TII.label: kwazaari chain shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TII.description: A drum-fed fully automatic shotgun which sprays destructive amounts of mildly-heated quasar alloy. Originally the weapon came strictly in semi-automatic but was quickly remachined into full automatic after illegally modified versions were confiscated following a ten second police firefight with tax evaders.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TII.label: kwazaari assault rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TII.description: A mass-produced rifle that is resistant to most forms of stress and abuse, while also being cheap to repair. While highly adjustable and customizable many of the parts do not come with the weapon itself, sold as separate overpriced pieces by haggling vendors, thankfully it does come with a variety of holographic flip-up sights and a compensator.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TII.label: kwazaari sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TII.description: Little more than a tube of Quasar metal, a bolt, and a stock, The Kwazaari sniper rifle is a by-product of a quite literal cutthroat business environment, where a bad deal can be the difference between a promotion and unmarked shallow grave.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_LMG_TII.label: kwazaari lmg
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_LMG_TII.description:
A box of dangerously strong bullets belt-fed into a hulking behemoth of a weapon, the Kwazaari LMG is capable of suppressing an entire boardroom for the duration of three conference calls or your money back* 



*No Refunds, All Sales Final
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FlakVest.label: tenebral flak vest
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FlakVest.descriptio: Two plates of Tenebrite Crystalline Mesh riveted together to create the pinnacle of torso protection. This protective vest can withstand being hit by a railgun without so much as a dent, though the same cannot be said for the wearer's unprotected limbs.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FlakPants.label: tenebral flak pants
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FlakPants.descripti: Fashionable pants reinforced with Tenebrite Crystals. It's protective qualities are second-to-none while also remaining comfortable and easy to wear... and it even comes in black and red, sexy!
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FlakJacket.label: tenebral flak jacket
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FlakJacket.descript: A thick jacket reinforced with Tenebrite Crystals, offering protection to a larger amount of the Upper Body at a slightly lower level than the Tenebrite Vest. Often issued to Tenebral Agents who are assigned frigid climates due to its greater insulatory qualities.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_PowerArmor.label: tenebral marine armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_PowerArmor.descript: A hellish suit of shadowy powered armor, reinforced with Tenebral Crystals. It is said a soldier wearing a full set of powered Tenebral Armor can survive the detonation of an antigrain warhead.\n\nOftentimes those who see it on the battlefield do not live to tell the tale of the dreaded "Death-Suits", those who do probably ran the moment they saw shadowy specks on the horizon.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorRecon.label: tenebral recon armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorRecon.descript: A lighter suit of shadowy powered armor which makes use of Tenebral Crystals, designed with flawless mobility in mind. Despite its appearance, the armor can still absorb a conventional tank shell while permitting the wearer to move at supernatural speed.\n\nDue to the intensity of the assaults by those wearing this armor, many on the Rim call their wearers "Death Machines, fueled by Blood".
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_PowerArmorHelmet.de: A hellish and shadowy powered helmet, with a full suite of targeting and ballistic softwares while still being strong enough to take a conventional missile and remain unscathed.\n\nThe rarity of these helmets lends itself to the efficacy of Tenebral Death Troopers.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorHelmetRecon.de: A lightweight helmet reinforced with Tenebral Crystals.\n\nHighly coveted by Special Operations Agents for its wide array of tools, including but not limited to: Compass, GPS, Thermal Visor, Long and Short-Range Radio, Altometer, Beard-Trimmer, and many more.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralQuantumRebreatherMask.label: tenebral quantum rebreather mask
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralQuantumRebreatherMask.descri: An apex filtered quantum rebreather built for the harshest substrate environments.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralSunforgeCalibrationVisor.des: An apex visor that filters glare and timing drift for precision forging.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralQuantumHapticGloves.label: tenebral quantum haptic gloves
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralQuantumHapticGloves.descript: Apex haptic gloves tuned for microscopic substrate handling.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralSunforgeWeldersCoat.label: tenebral sunforge welder's coat
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralSunforgeWeldersCoat.descript: An apex heat-resistant coat with field-dampening panels for the most hostile forge lines.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicAssemblyHarness.label: tenebral bionic assembly harness
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicAssemblyHarness.descri: An apex torso harness that braces the shoulders and upper back for exact assembly at extreme throughput.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralPrecisionAssemblyGloves.desc: Apex structured sensor gloves with haptic sub-dermal guides.
LanguageData.BOR_Adreamoline.label: adreamoline
LanguageData.BOR_Adreamoline.description: An advanced chemical compound made from liquefied Sunsteel and specially prepared Tenebrite, adreamoline negates the user's need for rest, allowing them to function for indefinitely without getting tired. Due to the glaring imperfections within Sunsteel, there is a small but negligible risk of addiction.
LanguageData.BOR_Crewmates.label: crewmates
LanguageData.BOR_Crewmates.description: A vastly improved version of the more common recreational drinks which involve the use of Sunweave, Tenebrite is substituted instead of common water and draws out immensely pleasurable compounds from within the powdered Sunweave. Like all drugs based upon Sunsteel, there is a small risk of addiction - though the addition of Tenebrite seems to have lowered it even further.\n\nThis specific formula is often used aboard small-population transport ships to dull the monotony of their day-to-day maintenance.
LanguageData.BOR_Gallop.label: gallop
LanguageData.BOR_Gallop.description: Considered both a Psychedelic and Steroid, Gallop has several uses in both the Civilian and Military markets, the most common effects of Gallop consumption include superhuman speed, reaction times, and in the original trial tests: the immensely rare case of Multitudinous Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection (MSCAD).\n\nWhile it has no tangible effect on Temporal Reality, the level to which both the human consciousness and nervous system are elevated renders conventional perceptions of spacetime rather sluggish, for better or worse.
LanguageData.BOR_Pax.label: pax
LanguageData.BOR_Pax.description: A "miracle drug" in all but name, Pax renders the user incapable of becoming ill or suffering from the most negative effects of age.\n\nThere have been wars fought over doses of Pax by 'lesser cultures', primarily for the amusement of the Tenebral Dominion.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebrite.label: tenebrite crystals
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebrite.description: An utterly unique, crystalline material composed of microscopic black holes, weakly-interacting massive particles, and other particles which do not directly interact with everyday matter. In place of covalent and ionic bonds, Tenebrite Crystals use the small-scale extreme gravity of its components in order to hold itself together without damaging normal matter that it may happen to come into contact with. \n\nIn Layman's Terms, this is arguably one of the strongest and lightest materials even the Archotechs could dare imagine possible.
LanguageData.BOR_ComponentIII.label: crystalline joints
LanguageData.BOR_ComponentIII.description: Terrifyingly useful and multi-faceted components used in any and all Tenebral Technology, capable of customization to fit any and all roles you could require of a generic component and then some.
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineIII.label: dark medicine
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineIII.description: A small pouch of medical tools which glow an unsettling blood-red, many of the tools are equipped with holographic projectors which allow even novitiate surgeons to perform advanced techniques with relative ease.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ShieldBelt.label: tenebral shield belt
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ShieldBelt.descript: A tenebral projectile-repulsion device. It will attempt to stop incoming projectiles or shrapnel, but does nothing against melee attacks or heat. It prevents the wearer from firing out, and shuts down instantly if hit by EMP.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_Autopistol_TIII.label: tenebral pistol bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_Shotgun_TIII.label: shotgun tenebral blast
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_AssaultRifle_TIII.label: assault rifle tenebral bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_SniperRifle_TIII.label: sniper rifle tenebral bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TIII.label: tenebral pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TIII.description: A deceptively simplistic handgun, Tenebrite Crystal shards fired at high velocity are deathly no matter the size. This weapon is lethal, but comparatively weak within the Tenebral Dominion's armories
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TIII.label: tenebral chain shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TIII.description: A fully automatic shotgun reinforced with Tenebrite Crystals, often employed by Dominion death troopers who need to cut through hordes of enemy infantry like a scythe through wheat.\n\n "Rip and Tear, until it is done." -Standard Issue Tenebral Infantryman's Primer, Page 7 - Section Gamma
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TIII.label: tenebral assault rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TIII.description: A black rifle with blood-red highlights, capable of consistently and accurately firing bolts of Tenebrite downrange. Often colloquially called a "Hellgun" by enemies of the Tenebral Domain, it is uncertain if more have been killed with the weapon or over the privilege of using one.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TIII.label: tenebral sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TIII.description: "It is not my place to say, but if the Tenebral Dominion wishes for someone to die, they use one of these bad boys, and that person f*@#ing dies." -Kwazaari Arms Dealer Ma'ash Dul'a
